A1.justification: Both PDFs describe HoVLE and contain complete, corresponding main sections, Appendices A–C, equations, tables, figures and references. Text and rendered-page comparisons support a reliable assessment.

before.justification: v1 reports original HoVLE benchmark results, ablations, attention visualizations and inference measurements in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, with revised GQA scores and benchmark averages in Tables 2, 6 and 13.

M1.justification: The holistic embedding architecture, InternLM2 backbone, distillation and alignment objectives, instruction tuning, and high-resolution variant are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 17 evaluation benchmarks and the same training datasets and task coverage documented in Appendix A.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–2 and the supplementary comparisons, including EVE-7B (HD), Emu3 and InternVL2.

E3.justification: Reported training budgets, model configurations, evaluation metrics, inference input/output lengths and tested resolutions remain identical. No protocol revision is documented alongside the changed scores.

E4.justification: The same embedding-depth, training-stage, text-data and distillation-scaling ablations, attention analyses and speed-resolution study are retained. No analysis is added or removed; existing numerical results are revised.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed specifications, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 2 changes HoVLE/HoVLE (HD) GQA from 63.6/64.9 to 61.0/60.4, reversing their ordering and placing both below EVE-7B (HD)'s unchanged 62.6. Table 13 changes GQA at resolutions 336/392/448 from 63.7/64.9/64.9 to 60.8/60.7/60.4. Table 6 averages change from 65.7/66.1/66.8 to 65.5/65.9/66.5. These are localized revisions under unchanged reported settings.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 and their mathematical definitions and objectives are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims of competitive compositional-model performance and substantial improvements over earlier monolithic models.

C2.justification: Interpretations of distillation, sparse attention and resolution benefits, and the limitation concerning experiments at approximately 2B scale, remain unchanged. The revised GQA results receive no new explanation or qualification.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain identical implementation details, hyperparameters and dataset descriptions. Model-access information and external link targets are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning relative to compositional and monolithic VLMs, and all 135 references remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp changes, from v1 dated 20 December 2024 to v2 dated 9 February 2025. Prose, terminology and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 moves the GQA boldface from HoVLE (HD)'s 64.9 to HoVLE's 61.0. This incorrectly leaves EVE-7B (HD)'s higher 62.6 unhighlighted. Figures, table structures, captions and page layouts otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The score revisions introduce a limited reporting inconsistency: v1 correctly highlights HoVLE (HD)'s 64.9 as the best monolithic GQA result, whereas v2 highlights HoVLE's 61.0 despite EVE-7B (HD)'s higher 62.6. The caption still defines boldface as the best score. This slightly weakens reporting reliability; the lower numerical results themselves do not establish a decline in paper quality.
